item.title: Functional Principal Component Analysis
item.description: This work is part of project done for a class in the MSc Applied Mathematics in the Autonomous University of Madrid. You can find the complete work here. In this manuscript, we explore the application of dimensionality reduction algorithms to real-world datasets within the context of functional data analysis. We establish several theoretical results related to Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for functional data and introduce a novel variation, Fourier PCA, inspired by Fourier theory.
